description: The file defines a configuration class and methods for handling Google Gemini image generation API interactions, including parameter mapping, URL construction, environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing.

classes.name: GoogleImageGenConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Google Gemini image generation API, providing methods for parameter support, URL construction, environment validation, request and response transformation.

methods.name: str _map_size_to_aspect_ratio(self, size: str)
